parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood. It forms the outer shell and internal support for the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the doors and stored items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding door of the cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the left compartment of the cabinet by sliding horizontally.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along a track to open or close the left side of the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding door of the cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the right compartment of the cabinet by sliding horizontally.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along a track to open or close the right side of the cabinet.
